newsitem.title: USA: AmeriResource Tech buys resort stake.
newsitem.headline: AmeriResource Tech buys resort stake.

text.p: AmeriResource Technologies Inc said Wednesday it signed an agreement with First Development LLC to buy a 20 percent stake in a project to be built on 1,800 acres of land in St. Lucia and in an existing hotel and property in St. Croix.
The company said its investment totaled $9 million, while the projects have a total value of more than $34 million.
The St. Lucia design includes a hotel, golf course, tennis courts and a casino, the company said.
AmeriResource Technologies is a full-service consulting and construction firm.
